en.summary: Yemeni forces advanced against Houthi militia near Bab al-Mandab, with Al-Amalqa and Shield of the Nation forces regaining control of Dhubab district with air support. Several Houthi fighters surrendered after being encircled, with dozens reported killed in the western coastal fighting.
